tools.name: smartmontools
tools.desc: Command-line SMART reader for SSDs and hard drives.
tools.why: Install it and TM Toolset's Drive Health tab shows wear, temperature, power-on hours and error counts instead of a bare pass/fail. brew install smartmontools.

tools.name: DriveDx
tools.desc: Detailed SSD and hard-drive health with early-warning indicators.
tools.why: The most thorough drive-health app on the Mac, with clear failing-soon verdicts.

tools.name: coconutBattery
tools.desc: Battery health for the Mac, and for an iPhone or iPad plugged into it.
tools.why: Quick second opinion on battery capacity, and it reads iOS device batteries too.

tools.name: EtreCheck
tools.desc: One-click report on a Mac's hardware, software and problems.
tools.why: The long-standing Mac troubleshooting report; useful to compare against.

tools.name: Stats
tools.desc: Menu-bar monitor for CPU, GPU, memory, disks, sensors and fans.
tools.why: Free and open source - live temperatures and fan speeds while you work on a machine.

tools.name: Mactracker
tools.desc: Specifications for every Mac, iPhone and iPad Apple has made.
tools.why: Look up maximum RAM, supported macOS versions and original spec for any model on the bench.

tools.name: Malwarebytes for Mac
tools.desc: Scanner for Mac adware, malware and unwanted programs.
tools.why: The standard clean-up tool when a Mac has adware or a hijacked browser.

tools.name: KnockKnock
tools.desc: Shows everything set to run persistently on a Mac.
tools.why: From Objective-See: lists launch items, extensions and more, with VirusTotal checks.

tools.name: LuLu
tools.desc: Free, open-source outbound firewall.
tools.why: See and block what is calling out from a suspect Mac.

tools.name: OnyX
tools.desc: Maintenance, cache clearing and hidden-settings tool.
tools.why: Rebuilds caches and databases and runs maintenance scripts. Download the build matching the macOS version.

tools.name: AppCleaner
tools.desc: Removes an app together with its leftover support files.
tools.why: Clean uninstalls, including the launch agents an app leaves behind.

tools.name: GrandPerspective
tools.desc: Visual map of what is using disk space.
tools.why: Find what filled the startup disk at a glance.

tools.name: Carbon Copy Cloner
tools.desc: Disk cloning and scheduled backups.
tools.why: The tool for cloning a customer's data to a new drive or taking a safety copy before repair work.

tools.name: SuperDuper!
tools.desc: Simple disk cloning and backup.
tools.why: Straightforward clone-before-you-work tool; the free mode does full copies.

tools.name: TestDisk & PhotoRec
tools.desc: Partition repair and file recovery.
tools.why: Free, open-source recovery of lost partitions and deleted files.

tools.name: Mist
tools.desc: Downloads macOS installers and firmware (IPSW) from Apple.
tools.why: Get the exact macOS installer or Apple silicon restore image you need.

tools.name: Apple Configurator
tools.desc: Revive or restore Mac firmware, and set up iPhones and iPads.
tools.why: Needed to revive a T2 or Apple silicon Mac that will not start (DFU mode). From the Mac App Store.

tools.name: Homebrew
tools.desc: Package manager for command-line tools.
tools.why: The easy way to install smartmontools, libimobiledevice and other technician tools.

tools.name: libimobiledevice
tools.desc: Command-line tools for talking to iPhones and iPads.
tools.why: Powers the Apple Devices tab. brew install libimobiledevice.

tools.name: OpenBoardView
tools.desc: Viewer for boardview files.
tools.why: Open boardviews from the Board Repair library on the Mac.
